churches.name: Selah Church
churches.assessment: Selah is a young, Spirit-filled church led by genuinely gospel-loving people. Luke Taylor is a sincere pastor with solid theology on the essentials — Christ is the only way, the Bible is authoritative, gender is binary. But structural concerns are real: no elder accountability, women functioning in pastoral roles, and a spiritual formation emphasis that can trend contemplative rather than expository. If you're a man who needs clear authority structures and complementarian conviction, visit with your eyes open. If you're a new believer or seeking family, you'll find genuine love here. Just ask the hard questions early.

churches.name: Revive Church Fredericksburg
churches.pastor: Jeremy Duggins (Lead Pastor) & Erica Duggins (Co-Lead Pastor)
churches.pastor_credentials: Unknown — Jeremy served 7 years as associate pastor before becoming lead; co-founded Revive School discipleship program
churches.services: Sunday mornings (two-part service format; check website for times)

score_notes.scripture: Charismatic/presence-focused church may emphasize prophetic experience alongside Scripture; no formal inerrancy statement found
score_notes.gender: Erica Duggins holds co-lead pastor title — raises complementarian questions; no explicit statement on gender roles found
score_notes.leadership: Couple as co-lead pastors with no visible elder board structure; accountability unclear
score_notes.preaching: Presence-focused, charismatic style likely topical/experiential rather than expository
score_notes.mens: No dedicated men's ministry found; offers Revive Groups and community involvement

churches.assessment: Revive Church is a vibrant, mission-focused charismatic church with clear evangelical convictions on salvation and the centrality of Christ. The 'house for God's presence' framing reflects a genuine Spirit-first culture. Key watch items: Jeremy and Erica Duggins serve as co-lead pastors (Erica's pastoral title is a complementarian yellow flag), no visible elder accountability structure, and the presence/experience emphasis may crowd out systematic biblical teaching. Friend Aaron Ranford attends — worth a personal conversation about what he's found there doctrinally. Could be a great community for mission-minded men who are strong in their own theology.

churches.name: St. George's Episcopal Church
churches.pastor: The Rev. Joseph H. Hensley Jr.
churches.pastor_credentials: DMin, Virginia Theological Seminary; ordained deacon and priest 2007; rector since 2015
churches.services: Multiple Sunday services (call office for times: 540-373-4133)

score_notes.christology: Nominally affirms Christ but TEC's broad inclusivism increasingly softens exclusivity claims
score_notes.scripture: The Episcopal Church (TEC) has formally departed from biblical authority on sexuality and gender — affirms same-sex marriage, LGBTQ+ ordination
score_notes.gender: Explicitly advertises inclusivity of 'sexual orientation and gender expression'; women are ordained priests and bishops in TEC; he/him pronouns listed voluntarily in staff bios
score_notes.leadership: Women serve in all clergy roles including rector; no male-elder requirement; diocesan leadership is progressive
score_notes.soteriology: Episcopal tradition broadly views salvation; TEC leans universalist in practice if not confession
score_notes.cultural: Facebook page explicitly states 'You are welcome here inclusive of race, nationality, sexual orientation, gender expression' — DEI language built into church identity
score_notes.denomination: Diocese of Virginia provides accountability but to progressive denominational hierarchy
score_notes.preaching: Liturgical/lectionary-based; homilies typically brief and thematic rather than expository
score_notes.mens: No evidence of intentional men's discipleship; primary community focus
score_notes.mission: Service and community orientation; Great Commission clarity unclear

churches.assessment: St. George's is a historic colonial-era church with a beautiful building and rich liturgical tradition, but The Episcopal Church has made formal institutional commitments to LGBTQ+ affirmation that place it outside biblical alignment on sexuality, gender, and in many ways Scripture's final authority. The rector is credentialed and experienced, but VTS (Virginia Theological Seminary) is among the most progressive Episcopal seminaries. For Moop who applied for employment here — the job opportunity doesn't require theological agreement, but discipleship-wise this is not the church to call home.

churches.name: Fawn Lake Church
churches.address: 10127 Plank Rd (Rt. 3), Spotsylvania, VA (meets at Laurel Hill Chapel)
churches.services: Sunday mornings at 9:30 AM at Laurel Hill Chapel

score_notes.gender: No explicit complementarian or egalitarian statement found; unknown stance
score_notes.leadership: No leadership team info found publicly; small community church with limited web presence
score_notes.denomination: Independent; no denominational accountability structure visible
score_notes.preaching: Preaching style unknown; small church with limited online content to evaluate

churches.assessment: Fawn Lake Church has an encouraging doctrinal foundation — they explicitly affirm Trinitarian orthodoxy, biblical inspiration, and salvation through Christ alone. Their mission statement includes both Great Commission language and community reconciliation, which is healthy. The church is small and community-focused, meeting at Laurel Hill Chapel. Major unknowns: who leads it, what preaching style looks like, stance on gender roles, and whether there's any substantive discipleship infrastructure. Moop applied here for employment — before any deeper relationship, worth attending a service and asking direct questions about leadership, accountability, and biblical authority on gender/sexuality.

churches.name: The Mount Church (Fredericksburg Campus)
churches.pastor_credentials: B.A. in Missions, Trinity Baptist College (Jacksonville, FL); former missionary in Poland (2.5 years)
churches.founded: Unknown (formerly Mount Ararat Church; rebranded as The Mount)
churches.denomination: Baptist (affiliated with BGAV — Baptist General Association of Virginia)
churches.services: Sunday mornings (live worship; teaching streamed from Stafford campus)

score_notes.gender: BGAV (Baptist General Association of Virginia) is the moderate/progressive Virginia Baptist body — allows women in pastoral roles; stance unclear at local campus level
score_notes.leadership: Campus pastor model; primary teaching comes via video/stream from Stafford campus rather than local preacher — reduces direct pastoral relationship
score_notes.cultural: BGAV affiliation carries moderate Baptist drift risk; no explicit DEI language found but denomination leans progressive compared to SBC
score_notes.denomination: BGAV affiliation (not SBC); BGAV is the 'Cooperative Baptist Fellowship'-adjacent body in Virginia — moderate theologically
score_notes.preaching: Multi-site model: Fredericksburg campus receives sermon via video from Stafford; Andrew Brothers leads local worship but doesn't preach weekly
score_notes.mens: No dedicated men's discipleship program found for Fredericksburg campus

churches.assessment: The Mount Fredericksburg has a campus pastor, Andrew Brothers, with a solid missions background and genuine evangelistic heart. The 'church For One More' vision is outreach-forward in a healthy way, and the Baptist DNA keeps the basics in place. Two key concerns: (1) BGAV affiliation places them in the moderate Virginia Baptist stream rather than SBC — BGAV allows women pastors and leans progressive denominationally; (2) the multi-site streaming model means the congregation watches Stafford's sermon via video rather than hearing Andrew preach, which weakens local pastoral voice and relationship. Worth a visit; go in knowing you're in moderate Baptist territory, not SBC.

churches.name: Spotswood Baptist Church
churches.pastor: Dr. Drew Landry (Senior Pastor); Dr. Dan Cook (Executive Pastor / Minister of Education, serving since 1994)
churches.pastor_credentials: Dan Cook: BS Pastoral Theology (Hyles-Anderson College), MA Religion + MA Religious Education (Liberty Baptist Theological Seminary), EdD (Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary)
churches.founded: Pre-1994 (established; Dr. Cook has served since 1994)
churches.denomination: Southern Baptist Convention (SBC of Virginia / SBCV)

score_notes.mens: Dr. Cook oversees all discipleship and adult ministries with passion for small-group disciple-making, but no standalone men's ministry specifically confirmed on website

churches.assessment: Spotswood Baptist is the most theologically squared-up church on this list. SBC affiliation means clear complementarian conviction, Scripture inerrancy, and Great Commission focus. Dr. Drew Landry leads as senior pastor while Dr. Dan Cook — who has served since 1994 with degrees from Liberty and Southeastern Baptist — provides deep discipleship infrastructure. The values (Vertical Worship, Transformational Teaching, Biblical Community, Missional Living) map cleanly onto what a man seeking solid formation needs. Two services on Sundays, well-resourced, clearly evangelical. Moop has a meeting with Dr. Cook — that relationship alone is worth pursuing. This is a church worth taking seriously.
